    if not car_patches: return image_patch
    
    # Find all street patches
    street_patches = image_patch.find("street")
    
    if not street_patches: return car_patches[0]
    
    # Sort cars by their horizontal center
    car_patches.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    
    # Check which side of the street each car is on
    left_cars = [c for c in car_patches if c.horizontal_center < street_patches[0].horizontal_center]
    right_cars = [c for c in car_patches if c.horizontal_center >= street_patches[0].horizontal_center]
    
    # Select the car on the side of the street
    if left_cars:
        return left_cars[0]
    elif right_cars:
        return right_cars[0]
    else:
        return car_patches[0]
